items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: He's a, he was a good man on it. I just heard him play it a few times.

ctx.x: He knowed it. Mostly he played clarinet or mostly alto at that time?

Huh? Clinet. Mostly clarinet. Okay. He's a, he was a good man on it. I just heard him play it a few times. He got around him. Well, tell me about that advertisement you had on the wagon. How did that happen? Um, I, uh, I, uh, I, uh, advertised for this guy here on Degenfield Street.
Dick is, uh, the potato chips? Dick is potato chips.
